description: This file implements the ConfirmEmail page model for user email confirmation in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It handles email confirmation requests by verifying user ID and code, and updating the user record accordingly.

classes.name: ConfirmEmailModel
classes.description: Page model for managing email confirmation requests, handling email verification logic.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to confirm user's email by validating user ID and confirmation code, updating the email confirmation status, or redirecting/throwing on errors.
